method: Rows a person checked stay as they were. Costume and variant drafts are approved by tools/verify_costumes.py when an official Pokémon GO post is already cited, or when the game-data id is also on the independent event-form list. A later pass reads official posts and approves a leftover only when a post names that species in that costume. A second slot is merged when it is the same costume. The verifier last ran on 2026-11-21.
